record_title: Complete minimizer classification for the ultraspherical lower envelope
provenance: Equality-case refinement of Castillo--Sadigova, arXiv:2609.15473, combined with the original monotonicity question in de Oliveira Filho's 2009 thesis.
limitations: Restricted to normalized ultraspherical polynomials R_n^(alpha,alpha) with alpha>=0. No classification is claimed for asymmetric Jacobi parameters and no quantitative interior gap is optimized. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the source preprint is very recent and an unindexed contemporaneous observation remains a residual risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
